Jump3r 1.0.5 is an unmodified Java port of LAME licensed LGPL-2.1-or-later. Binary and complete source artifacts were downloaded from Maven Central (de.sciss:jump3r:1.0.5). Upstream: https://git.iem.at/sciss/jump3r . The license is included in app/src/main/assets/licenses/jump3r-LGPL-2.1.txt. To replace the encoder, build a modified compatible JAR from the supplied source, replace app/libs/jump3r-1.0.5.jar, and build/reinstall the APK using Gradle. The application adapter Mp3AudioEncoder.java accesses the core API directly without desktop javax.sound dependencies.
